name: b11 — Figure Sequences, exam-alignment pass (1/12/15)

currentCoverage.note: node scripts/audit-bank.mjs and a direct read of questions.json, 22 November 2026, against the 87 ACTIVE items (86 of 173 are quarantined for direction-cycle and reach no pool)
currentCoverage.observation: The rotating-symbol histogram stops dead at 2, and not by choice. `ROTATABLE` held exactly two shapes — triangle and arrow — and a shape may not repeat within an item, so three rotating symbols was unreachable by construction in all 87 active items. The brief reports several figures turning in different directions in the live sitting, so this is the single binding gap in the subtest.

overrepresented: at most two rotating symbols per item (87 of 87 items)
arrow and triangle as the rotating carriers (every rotating symbol in the bank is one of the two)
items where rotation is carried by a single symbol (46 of 87)
gaps: three and four rotating symbols in one item — zero items, structurally impossible before this batch
opposed rotation directions within one item
visually confusable pairs — the bank has no two shapes a candidate could mistake for one another
right-angle triangles and lightning/zigzag figures, both reported from the sitting

allowed: linear and diagonal movement at 1 field, bounce-as-reversal
border travel cw/ccw at 1, 2 or x+1 fields
colour cycles of 2 or 3 colours, all visible in the shown matrices
review: rotation on right-triangle and bolt — FS_CONTRACT.review.rotationShapes; the rotation rule itself is stated for the subtest, but no official exercise turns either shape
static rotating symbol (not used in this batch — the pilot items still await human sign-off)
forbidden: direction-cycle — quarantined, and the reason 86 items are out of every pool
billiard reflection as the correct boundary behaviour
linear or diagonal movement above one field per step other than x+1, including in distractors
figures disappearing, overlapping or leaving the matrix
shown matrices admitting more than one legal continuation
a colour cycle containing a colour never shown

difficultyModel.metric: peak transformation load on a single symbol, measured after simulation, never inherited from the plan
difficultyModel.medium: 2-3 symbols, peakLoad == 3 — at least one symbol stacking movement with rotation and colour, the official Ex 3 / Ex 4 standard
difficultyModel.high: 3-4 symbols, peakLoad >= 4, reached by acceleration or by stacking movement + rotation + colour on a symbol that also meets a wall

distractorConstraints.perImage: two distinct families, at most one positional nudge
distractorConstraints.note: A rotation-heavy item makes the rotation and colour families carry more of the load by construction: with every symbol turning, a distractor that differs only in one symbol's facing is both plausible and genuinely close to the correct panel. That is the brief's 'incorrect options visually close to the correct answer', and it comes from the item shape rather than from a change to the distractor code.

structuralConstraints.lowTierCeiling: 0 items. The low tier is 1 symbol with movement only, so its distinct fingerprint space is nearly exhausted — a consequence of the direction-cycle quarantine, not a choice. This batch originally took its one remaining slot; the item was then dropped, because a fresh batch could no longer place ANY low item afterwards and the capacity test that watches this is worth more than one easy question in a batch whose whole purpose is harder material.
structuralConstraints.rotationHeavyShare: 10 of 28 items (36%) — enough to make three- and four-rotator items ordinary rather than exotic, while leaving the majority of the batch on the documented single- and double-rotator shapes

seedStrategy: Per-slot seeds from (generator, section, batchId, tier, index, attempt), as scripts/lib/seed.mjs defines. Append-only: no existing id is touched and every committed item must still rebuild byte-identically from its own stamp. Measured success rates for the new mechanic are 15.7% (medium, 2 symbols), 6.4% (medium, 3), 15.0% (high, 3) and 4.0% (high, 4) against a 4000-attempt budget per slot.

expectedDistribution.medium: 12 items at peakLoad 3 — 4 rotation-heavy, 2 forced to 3 symbols, 6 drawn freely
expectedDistribution.high: 15 items at peakLoad >= 4 — 3 rotation-heavy with 4 symbols, 3 rotation-heavy with 3, 2 forced to 4 symbols for the official Ex 5 / Ex 6 shape, 7 drawn freely
